**Show all your reasoning.** Total: **52 marks** · Suggested time: **70 minutes**. No calculator. Every question
is exam standard. (No $e$ or $\ln$ — all in-spec.)

| Section | What it covers | Marks |
|---|---|---|
| **A — Quadratic in $a^x$** | substitute $u=a^x$, reject $u\le0$ | 10 |
| **B — Quadratic in $\log x$** | substitute $L=\log_a x$ | 7 |
| **C — Simultaneous log/exp** | clear the logs / substitute $A=a^x,B=a^y$ | 12 |
| **D — Linearisation** | read gradient & intercept of a log plot | 10 |
| **E — Existence, signs & base below 1** | $a>0,\ a\ne1,\ b>0$; four sign cases; flip for $0<a<1$ | 13 |

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Answer form.** Solutions for $x$ → exact values (reject any that break a domain or give $u\le0$). Constants
$A,b,n$ → exact values. When two solutions exist, give **both**.
:::
